name: Wire Cubes
description: Wireframe cubes, one to a cell, each turned so its far face points toward the middle of the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: scale(@calc(round((1 - 2 * (@dx > 0)) * 100) / 100), @calc(round((2 * (@dy >= 0) - 1) * 100) / 100)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--cf); clip-path: @var(--cf); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color3); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--cb); clip-path: @var(--cb); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
